outcome: Mother's perception of the onset of lactation
cohort: The study included 117 healthy women and their normal full-term infants.
finding: High infant suction pressure was directly associated with a greater post-natal prolactin increment and an earlier perceived onset of lactation, and inversely correlated with a mother's perception of insufficient milk supply.
birth_weight: Normal full-term infants were included; infant birth weight was analyzed as a variable.
gest_age: Normal full-term infants were included; gestational age was analyzed as a variable.
